282:t_2:16.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「They even assimilated $$宇宙怪獣$$, so it makes no difference whether something's organic or inorganic.」

282:t_2:18.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「...We cannot classify the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ as $$バアル$$ yet. However, they are just as dangerous.」

282:t_2:19.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Their assimilation attacks damage pilots too. If an attack knocks you unconscious, you can only become their prey.」

282:t_2:20.en:
$$オズマ$$
「When we fight them again, we'll have to pull back anyone who can no longer fight.」

282:t_2:21.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I'd rather never see them again, if possible.」

282:t_2:23.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「We can't say at present. They may have entered this solar system because of some accident...」

282:t_2:24.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Or they may be scouts ahead of a main force.」

282:t_2:25.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We have no effective tactics against $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ assimilation. If a large force comes, all humanity will be in danger.」

282:t_2:28.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「In any case, we don't have enough data yet.」

282:t_2:29.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「For now, all we can do is pray they never return.」

282:t_2:30.en:
$$リンダ$$
「Still, we'll send data on the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ to each facility in the $$木星$$ sector and urge them to stay alert.」

282:t_2:31.en:
$$リンダ$$
「Then we'll observe $$バアル$$ activity, including the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, from here.」

282:t_2:33.en:
$$リンダ$$
「We'll be fine, $$ミレイナ$$. You need to return to Earth, tell them what's happened, and fight the Empire.」

282:t_2:34.en:
$$イアン$$
「That's right. ...Despite the trouble, we'll soon finish resupplying all the ships.」

282:t_2:35.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Then all $c ships will return to the Earth Sphere via $$火星$$.」

282:t_2:36.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Begin preparations to depart. We leave this base in 24 hours.」

282:t_2:37.en:
$$アルト$$
「...A new kind of $$バアル$$...?」

282:t_2:38.en:
$$シェリル$$
「You shouldn't jump to conclusions like that.」

282:t_2:39.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Some people look delicate enough to be girls, but they're bundles of fighting instinct underneath.」

282:t_2:41.en:
$$ランカ$$
「You know, $$アルト$$... I was thinking.」

282:t_2:42.en:
$$ランカ$$
「At first we couldn't understand the $$バジュラ$$, and they fought humanity. But in the end, we got our feelings across.」

282:t_2:43.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Maybe we could do the same with these creatures called $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...」

282:t_2:44.en:
$$アルト$$
「You mean let them hear you sing?」

282:t_2:45.en:
$$シェリル$$
「No. We're saying there might be some way to get our feelings across.」

282:t_2:46.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'd like to try that plan too.」

282:t_2:49.en:
$$アルト$$
「Y-yes... I could understand $$バサラ$$ saying it, but...」

282:t_2:50.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...Those creatures, the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$... I don't think they're $$バアル$$.」

282:t_2:52.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't sense the urge to destroy that the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$インベーダー#robot$$s have. Instead, I sense something like a will.」

282:t_2:53.en:
$$アルト$$
「Are you saying they're acting with a clear purpose?」

282:t_2:54.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I couldn't tell you what it is... It's just a feeling I have.」

282:t_2:55.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But I think it's worth trying.」

282:t_2:56.en:
$$アルト$$
「...Understood. I'll tell everyone else too.」

282:t_2:57.en:
$$シェリル$$
「I like that positive attitude of yours.」

282:t_2:59.en:
$$アルト$$
「First we need to get ready to depart. Our next destination is $$火星$$.」

282:t_2:62.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Did you think it was strange for me to say that too?」

282:t_2:64.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You sensed something from those $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ too, didn't you?」

282:t_2:66.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...$$刹那$$. Do you remember 《$$リボンズ$$》 Almark?」

282:t_2:68.en:
$$アムロ$$
「When I was with him, we discussed all sorts of things. This was one of them...」

282:t_2:69.en:
$$アムロ$$
「How should humanity communicate with another species that doesn't understand our language...?」

282:t_2:71.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't know what he intended by bringing it up.」

282:t_2:72.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But I'm certain he knew quite a lot about $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$'s plan.」

282:t_2:74.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The $$ダブルオークアンタ$$... I believe in that machine's potential.」

282:t_2:76.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Maybe it's because I've seen the galaxy myself... I feel that someday humanity will make all that vast space its home.」

282:t_2:77.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Maybe our job is to find a way for us to live out there...」

282:t_2:79.en:
$$刹那$$
「I don't know what $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ had in mind as he waited for the $$イノベイター$$s to awaken...」

282:t_2:80.en:
$$刹那$$
「But if that power can achieve something, I'll forge a path to the future with the $$クアンタ$$.」

282:t_2:82.en:
$$アムロ$$
(I suppose that must be my role, and $$刹那$$'s...)

282:t_10:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$. I've got something to take care of, so I'll be going.」

282:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course you do. Your long-distance girlfriend matters more than this squat little fellow, doesn't she~?」

282:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... I can't blame him. She's the girlfriend he saved by smashing her death flag, after all.」

282:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ロックオン$$'s efforts in front of her produced 50Z in $$Ｚチップ$$s from his high spirits. I'll add them to our stock.」

282:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A life that overturns fate... I'd like to follow his example.」

282:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, $$ミレイナ$$! You've come at just the right time!」

282:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Could you lend your assistance to this poor, pitiful $$ＡＧ$$, $$ミレイナ$$?」
